name: Dark Mode Button
description: Provides a block with an icon button to switch to dark mode.
library_dependencies: bootstrap-icons (loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net as an external CSS asset)
project_description: Dark Mode Button (dmb) is a small front-end module that exposes a single block containing an icon button which toggles a client-side dark theme. Clicking the button toggles a 'dark-mode' CSS class on the page body and persists the choice in the browser's localStorage, swapping a Bootstrap Icons moon/sun glyph to reflect the current state. All styling and state handling is client-side JavaScript and CSS; the module ships no routes, permissions, configuration, or server-side logic beyond a block plugin and a theme hook.
